entry.title: Building a research space
entry.content:
Research rarely fits neatly into a paper list. A publication records a result, but it often leaves out the implementation choices, failed directions, and connections to earlier work that made the result possible.

I built this site to keep those pieces together:

  • Research themes explain the longer questions behind individual projects.
  • Publications provide a hand-checked record that does not depend on indexing delays.
  • Projects connect technical ideas to reproducible implementations.
  • Field Notes create space for methods, experiments, and lessons that are useful before they become formal papers.

The common thread is an interest in combining wireless communications and signal processing with machine learning. I am particularly drawn to hybrid methods: systems that learn what is difficult to model while retaining the structure that makes classical estimators interpretable.

I will update this space as projects mature, papers become public, and new research questions emerge.
entry.summary: Why I am organizing my publications, projects, and technical notes in one place.

entry.title: Beyond research
entry.content:
Technical research is only one part of how I like to contribute. Student organizations, editorial work, and environmental outreach have given me opportunities to practice a different set of skills: communicating clearly, coordinating people, and turning an idea into something others can participate in.

At the Islamic University of Technology, I served as Chief Operations Officer of the IUT Career & Business Society. The role included planning events, coordinating operations, and developing sponsorship and communication materials. I also worked as an editor for Esonance, where I edited and organized articles and introductory material.

Environmental outreach is another continuing interest. Through Project Green, I have supported public-facing communication around community environmental action.

This section will grow into a less formal record of activities, writing, and interests beyond my research projects.
entry.summary: Student leadership, editing, and environmental outreach beyond the lab.
